phase: v3.9 Phase 2: BRIDGE long-gap action, risk-gated eta shrinkage (docs/v3_9_mirage_preregistration.md §4)

definitions.mixing: z(j,eta) = b + eta*(m_j - b) on the raw NaN mask only; observed-support drift exactly 0
definitions.risk_score: per-signal robust empirical CDF (train sources of each LODO fold, winsorised 1%/99%); R = max(width, disagreement, seam)
definitions.posterior_width: TS-ICL q90-q10 width over the gap / max(observed MAD, train q10 MAD floor) -- truncated/robust per §4
definitions.calibration: per fold: train-source-only normalisation; max-coverage grid point with train CHR CP95 upper <= 0.15; held-out source never normalises, selects or calibrates
definitions.label_path: experiments/v33_labels.py::compute_action_labels family 'IMPUTE', joined ONLY after the Phase-2 freeze; eta=1 label sets cross-checked against the Phase-1 probe
definitions.forbidden_signals: v3.4 shadow score and v3.5 prequential score are NOT used anywhere in this phase

linear_bridge.note: eta=0 checked on the bridge_tsicl rows (identical for all bases by the endpoint hash gate)

fixed_linear_bridge_direct.note: no risk gate; reference arm (eta=0 rows == frozen linear_bridge by the endpoint hash gate)

g1_harmful_auroc.rule: harmful AUROC >= 0.7 (LODO-normalised R, primary FM path fm_mean eta=1)

g2_auprc_lift.rule: AUPRC - random prevalence >= 0.1 (same score/labels as g1)

g3_lodo_workpoint_commits.rule: a train-selected LODO working point submits >= 15 commits on long blocks (pooled held-out commits of the six fold-selected points; per-fold detail reported)

g4_heldout_chr.rule: pooled held-out CHR <= 0.15 (LODO-selected working points, primary arm)

g5_source_noninferiority.rule: >= 4/6 sources with bridge B&S count >= tsicl's and harmful count <= tsicl's (long-gap windows of the source)

g6_pareto_vs_best_single_proposer.rule: vs the best single proposer (tsicl eta=1 direct): B&S non-decreasing with harmful reduced, or more B&S at the same harmful count

risk_head_branch.rule: ONE pre-registered training: monotone isotonic heads on the five normalised signals + R, model choice by source-group DRO (worst train-source Brier); the fixed grid/calibration protocol re-run once with the head score as the risk score
